images.filename: Església de Sant Jaume - Alcúdia - Main altar.jpg
images.caption: Main altar of the parish church Sant Jaume, Alcúdia, Majorca. The neo-gothic altar is a work of Llorenç Ferrer and Miquel Arcas. In the center the statue of St. James, St. Peter at the left side and St. Paul at he right. Between them eight boxes  with Saint Catherine Thomàs, the resurrection of Jesus, the flight to Egypt of the holy family,  the blessed Ramon Llull, the temptations of Jesus, Jesus knocking on the door, the Good Shepherd, and the garden prayer. At the bottom the four evangelists, thereover in the center the martyrdom of St. Peter and St. Paul, at the left gives Jesus the church keys to St. Peter, on the right the appearance of Santiago.
images.alt: Main altar of the parish church Sant Jaume, Alcúdia, Majorca. The neo-gothic altar is a work of Llorenç Ferrer and Miquel Arcas. In the center the statue of St. James, St. Peter at the left side and St. Paul at he right. Between them eight boxes  with Saint Catherine Thomàs, the resurrection of Jesus, the flight to Egypt of the holy family,  the blessed Ramon Llull, the temptations of Jesus, Jesus knocking on the door, the Good Shepherd, and the garden prayer. At the bottom the four evangelists, thereover in the center the martyrdom of St. Peter and St. Paul, at the left gives Jesus the church keys to St. Peter, on the right the appearance of Santiago.
